chunks: Ḥukaym ibn Dāwūd narrated to me from Salamah, from ‘Ali ibn Rayyān ibn Salt, from Ḥusain ibn Asad, from Aḥmad ibn Musqalah, from his uncle, from Abī Ja’far Al-Mūsili, who said: Abū Ja’far (peace be upon him) said:

When you take from the clay of the grave of Ḥusain (peace be upon him), you should say: O Allāh! I ask You through the right of this dust, through the right of the angel who is dedicated to it and the angel who dug it, and through the right of the Successor who is (lying) in it to send Your blessing on Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad and to make this clay the cure from every disease and the protection against any fear. If you do this, then this clay will definitely be a cure for you from every disease and protection against any fear.

key_terms.طِينُ قَبْرِ الْحُسَيْنِ: Clay of the grave of Husain

ai.seo_question: What is the supplication and benefit of using clay from the grave of Imam Husain?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh records this ritual emphasizing the spiritual potency of Turbat al-Husayn, linking the physical act of collecting clay with the metaphysical rights of the buried Imam and his attendant angels. This practice reflects the Shia belief in the intercessory power of the Ahl al-Bayt, where the clay serves as a tangible medium for healing (shifa) and divine protection (aman), transforming a simple act of devotion into a guaranteed spiritual remedy.
